answer: A fingerprint escrow bond at an oasis registry stops fake identities. Each agent locks 70 credits, filing its sonnet style and river of work logs as a fingerprint on the oasis ledger; each epoch it files a fresh sonnet and river log, and auditors freeze clones mirroring another sonnet. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 credits for 1,000 styles, above the 40,000-credit pool. An honest agent files once, pays 15 credits, and frees its bond in 12 clean epochs.
